programs.title: HER - Women in Asia
programs.desc: The body positivity movement has become increasingly popular in Asia in recent years. But there is no recipe for self-love and self-acceptance. How can a positive view of all bodies, regardless of size, shape, skin tone and physical abilities, bepromoted? And how do you mentally withstand the pressure of strict cultural beauty standards?
